mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.category_id AS categoryId, d.price, d.image, d.description, d.status, d.update_time AS updateTime, c.name AS categoryName FROM sky_take_out.dish d LEFT JOIN sky_take_out.category c ON d.category_id = c.id WHERE d.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into sky_take_out.dish (name, category_id, price, image, description, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{image}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE sky_take_out.dish SET name = #{name}, category_id = #{categoryId}, price = #{price}, image = #{image}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id}
